title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: multiple Sales Order Agents per company, with relevance filtering and larger PDF limits
summary: Pass. The roadmap details, administrative controls and Copilot Credit rates are supported, and the briefing accurately reports the conflicting folder guidance. Minor corrections should acknowledge the separate permissions guidance and remove checklist instructions for attachment controls that have no table row.
